edits.old: Then the retried activity writes the same values once and no snapshot row or publish row is duplicated
edits.new:
Then the retried activity writes the same values once and no snapshot row or publish row is duplicated

  Scenario: AC12 A consumed call that fails or does not answer records the failure and writes no row for its date (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given an activity of the workflow makes a consumed contract call for one business date
    When the call fails or no answer is returned
    Then the run records the failure with its business date
    Then no snapshot row and no publish row are written for that business date

  Scenario: AC13 A status change the model does not allow is refused (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a status change that the model does not allow for a record
    When the change is requested
    Then the change is refused and the record keeps its current status
    Then the refusal is recorded in the run with its business date
